messages:
alice: FYI canary in us-east is hung at post-upgrade hook. Pods are up but the postdeploy job is waiting on a DB migration lock.
ben: logs?
alice: from job: `migrate: waiting for lock on migration_version table (owner=old-release-123)`
maria: we intentionally serialize migrations. Looks like the previous release's migration didn't release lock in us-east (maybe stuck leader).
ci-bot: pipeline 3287654321: global promote started; regional workers applied chart to us-east which hit the migration lock. deploy-bot paused region.
alice: deploy-bot, status?
deploy-bot: Canary 3287654321-us-east paused due to postdeploy job timeout waiting on migration lock. Action: hold and notify release-ops.
release-ops: decision tree: 1) rollback chart in us-east until migration lock clears, 2) force-release lock and proceed (risky), 3) pin chart in us-east to previous stable version and continue global promotion. Window is 40m.
ben: rolling back would drop the feature flag changes we need. Force-releasing lock requires DB admin consent. Pinning regionally buys time and is reversible.
maria: agree on pin. We should annotate the release and create a follow-up to coordinate DB team to clear the lock and check why leader lingered.
alice: i'll prepare an overrides file that pins chart.version and skips postdeploy migrations: `overrides/us-east-skip-migrations.yaml` with `app.migrate=false` and `chart.version=4.3.1`.
ben: annotate with `temp-regional-pin=db-migration-lock` and set `temp-unpin-by=3287658000` in release metadata. Also record why in the release draft.
deploy-bot: queued job 3287654330 by alice: promote --env us-east --overrides overrides/us-east-skip-migrations.yaml --annotate "temp-regional-pin=db-migration_lock". ETA ~90s.
ci-bot: running preflight for regional override, ensuring skip-migrations flag is valid.
alice: preflight validated. Proceeding.
deploy-bot: upgrade applied with overrides; post-upgrade hooks skipped per flag. Pods report ready.
ben: running smoke tests now.
ci-bot: smoke tests passed. Canary healthy with regional pin. :white_check_mark:
release-ops: decision recorded: apply regional pin in us-east to avoid risky lock release and avoid rollback. Follow-up actions: 1) DB team to investigate lingering migration owner and clear safely; 2) unpin region after migrations confirmed; 3) add a gating preflight to check migration lock status before regional apply in future.
maria: opened DB issue and looped in @db-admins. Also filing a chart PR to make migrations more tolerant in rolling promos.
alice: updating /docs/release-drafts/3287.md with Known Issues entry and the `temp-unpin-by` ETA.
ben: leaving release annotation `temp-regional-pin=db-migration_lock` and adding comment `unpin-after=3287658000`.
release-ops: approved the plan. No rollback. Closing thread when unpin completes.
